title: Hatsune Miku — Happy Anniversary! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: The show's about to start, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: Can all of you watching the stream hear my voice okay?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Mikuuuuu!>
<I can hear you!>
<Finally!>

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line:
Hehe. Looks like we're all set.
So...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “The 100% Miku Anniversary Concert That We Build Together” starts...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
All of you in the audience!
All of you watching the stream!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for helping with this concert, which we are going to try to build together♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We'll go over each thing one by one.
Starting with the commemorative illustrations we received!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll show them all on the screens off to the sides of the stage as we keep our talk going.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We hope you enjoy what we have to say, but please don't forget to look at the pictures too.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<So many cute drawings of Miku! This is the best!>
<I need more eyes!>
<Are they gonna show the message I sent?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What's more, the set list for today's show will actually be decided by all of you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! They're totally stunned.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But that's okay! The process is actually really simple!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, Miku, why don't we jump right in and pick the first song?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All of you in the audience will need to get your phones out. All of you watching the stream can post your responses in the comments.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now, I know this is a bit sudden, but I have a question for all of you! “Which Miku would you all like to see?”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
A, “Cool Miku!”
B, “Cute Miku!” Please make your choices!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
“Cool Miku”, eh...?
Which song is that referring to, I wonder?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You'll have to wait to find out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, Rin, which Miku do you wanna see?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm gonna go with “Cute Miku”!
I mean, then I'd get to sing with―

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Easy, Rin!
That's supposed to be a secret, remember?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like the results are in...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's see... Everyone wants to see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: B, “Cute Miku”!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes! Let's do our best, Miku♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, and I hope all of you also have fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Our next song will be based on this question. “Which would you rather say right now?”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
A, “Thank you!”
B, “Happy anniversary!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think it's pretty easy to guess which songs these choices involve...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Again, you gotta wait to find out!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You guys in the crowd and watching online also have to keep it a secret if you've already figured it out! So, shh!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Our next one is...
Oh, it's “Which Miku would you all like to see?” again!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But this time, your choices are...
A, “Happy Miku.”
B, “Dark Miku.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which would you choose, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... I want to pick the one I'd be singing in, but I'm not involved in either of these...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, Rin, stop! Saying that you're not gonna be singing might give it away!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you all for helping make this a wonderfully exciting concert!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We only have a few minutes left together, but I hope you all enjoy the rest of our singing performances.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But before we continue, we need to present our usual messages!
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Miku!
I'm so glad that we were able to celebrate with you again this year.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's make sure everyone watching has fun as we sing and dance to the rest of our songs!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Miku!
I got to help out with a bunch of your songs, and you really put everything you had into all of them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I promise to also keep doing the same until the very end, so let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can tell just how motivated you are, Miku. There must have been just so many emotions that you wished to share with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I promise to support those feelings of yours by putting my heart into it as I sing. A very happy anniversary to you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Miku!
I've really been enjoying this show that we've been building together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There really is nothing like a concert that you built from the ground up with the audience! Let's stay joined as one and sprint to the finish line!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Miku.
The others more or less covered what I was going to say...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I hope this concert will be an unforgettable memory. For you, for this audience and for everybody watching.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I promise to sing with everything I have!
You all can still keep going, right?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you all for those thoughtful messages...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This wonderful concert wouldn't have been possible without the help of you and the others, KAITO. And all of you cheering for us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm here on stage today because I was sure that we could make this concert a fantastically fun one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope you all enjoy being here with us until the very last minute!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, let's start our final sprint!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We've actually got a special medley planned!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right. This medley will be a fun mix of “Cool Miku”, “Happy Anniversary!” feelings, and maybe even some “Happy Miku.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Does that mean?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Some of you already seem to have figured out what's going on here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The songs we're about to sing are all the ones for the answers which weren't chosen.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Quite a lot of you have been wondering what they were, yes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We practiced them all, so we wanted to perform them for you no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So, here we go!
Our special medley starts now♪
